title: Mission Control VPS - Phase 2 build and deployment
description: Create a separate VPS-hosted Mission Control app for app.missioncontroldb.online with modular dashboards for Ideas, Suggested Ideas, Projects, AI Builds, Tools, Systems, Automations, and Memory/Journal. Keep the current local Mission Control running separately, mirror progress into the local jobs board and memory journal, use Codex/GPT-5.4 for heavy build work, and deploy with secure VPS hosting, HTTPS, and resilient backups.

title: Mission Control VPS - Backup architecture
description: Implement nightly compressed backups on the VPS with rolling local retention and a secondary local-machine sync that fails gracefully when the PC is offline so the live app never breaks.

title: Mission Control VPS - Milestone C: Usage monitoring reliability
description: Finish and verify the 10-minute usage monitoring automation so snapshot refresh survives reboot/login cleanly, remains fresh without manual nudging, and exposes stale-data state when the feed stops.

title: Mission Control VPS - Milestone C: Multi-model chat stabilization
description: Stabilize Kimi K2.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Opus 4.6 so model routing, attribution, live reply updates, and messaging-style chat behavior are consistently correct.

title: Mission Control VPS - Milestone C: Current Tasks stability pass
description: Complete the final regression and usability pass on Current Tasks so create/edit/delete/drag and AI assignment remain stable in live use.

title: Mission Control VPS - Milestone D: Task execution engine
description: Build the first real execution flow so a task can be run from Mission Control by the selected model, produce output, and update task state through execution.

title: Mission Control VPS - Milestone E: Chat to task integration
description: Let chat create, assign, reference, and run tasks so the conversation interface becomes the control surface for Mission Control execution.

title: Mission Control VPS - Milestone F: Memory and continuity
description: Build daily journal automation and shared AI-readable continuity so future model runs understand current work without being re-explained from scratch.

title: Mission Control VPS - Milestone G: Operations and resilience
description: Add backup automation, health visibility, and recovery/admin tooling so the VPS app is sustainable and safe to operate long-term.

title: Mission Control VPS - Milestone H: Final polish and completion pass
description: Run the final UX, consistency, and completion verification pass so Mission Control feels coherent, dependable, and finished across chat, tasks, memory, monitoring, and operations.
